title: JSFL: scene management (addNewScene, deleteScene, renameScene, duplicateScene) + doc.arrange + element property batch API
description:
Add JSFL wrappers to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts that call existing core functions:

1. doc.addNewScene(name: string): void - calls core addScene(state.doc, name) and pushes updated doc. Look at how scene_add MCP tool works in packages/vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts for the pattern.
2. doc.deleteScene(): void - deletes current scene. Look at scene_remove MCP tool pattern.
3. doc.renameScene(name: string): void - renames current scene. Look at scene_rename MCP tool pattern.
4. doc.duplicateScene(): void - duplicates current scene. Core function duplicateScene exists in packages/core/src/model/document-mutations.ts.
5. doc.arrange(type: string): void - type is 'front'|'back'|'forward'|'backward'. Applies to state.selectedIds. Look at how stage_arrange MCP tool works for the core function to call.
6. doc.getElementProperty(propertyName: string): any - gets property from first selected element. Use the element proxy pattern (lines 280-314 in runtime.ts) to read the property from first item in state.selectedIds.
7. doc.setElementProperty(propertyName: string, value: any): void - sets property on ALL selected elements. Iterate selectedIds, set the property on each via the same update mechanism as moveSelectionBy.
8. doc.getTextString(): string - return first selected text object's text property, or empty string.
9. doc.setTextString(text: string): void - set text on all selected text objects.

Add all to JsflDocument interface + makeDocumentProxy.
